item.text:
The only added function computes the wrong divisor for the documented arithmetic mean and fails on a one-element list.

Review comment:

- [P1] Divide the total by the number of values — <REPO>/stats.py:6-6
  For any non-empty input, this divides by one less than the number of values, so the returned result is not the arithmetic mean (and a one-element input raises `ZeroDivisionError`). Divide by `len(values)` instead.
